note: Hand-labelled tuning set for the compliance relevance threshold. 'relevant' lists the knowledge-base files (by source name) whose principles genuinely apply to the query; an empty list means no KB file applies. 'borderline_sources' lists sources that a reasonable reviewer could label either way for that query; those (query, source) pairs are reported but excluded from precision/recall, while every other source for the query is scored normally. The four scenario groups use the requirements Agent 1 generated live for the evaluation scenarios on 2026-11-25. Labels were written by one person and the set is small, so treat the tuned threshold as a documented engineering choice, not a statistically validated one.

queries.text: The system shall allow users to create and publish short updates, photos, and videos.
The system shall allow users to follow and unfollow other user accounts.
The system shall allow users to add comments and reactions to existing posts.
The system shall support dynamic feature toggling to enable continuous releases and A/B experiments.
The system architecture shall be modular and decoupled to support frequent requirement changes and rapid continuous deployment.
The system shall render user feeds and media content within 2 seconds of user request under normal load conditions.
The system shall encrypt all user data and media assets both in transit and at rest.
The system shall calculate gross salaries, deductions, and applicable taxes for all 20,000 employees based on predefined HR policies.
The system shall generate individual electronic payslips for each employee following every completed payroll cycle.
The system shall generate accurate statutory filings required by tax and government authorities.
The system shall maintain a complete, immutable audit trail of all calculation overrides, data modifications, and payroll approvals.
The system shall ensure 100% computational accuracy for all salary and tax calculations without rounding discrepancies.
The system shall encrypt all employee financial and personal data both in transit and at rest.
The system shall complete the full payroll calculation cycle for all 20,000 employees within a 4-hour processing window.

groups.name: railway
groups.domain: Railway Signalling and Train Control System

queries.text: The system shall manage and control track signals to ensure safe separation between trains.
The system shall execute interlocking logic to prevent conflicting route assignments.
The system shall issue, modify, and revoke movement authorities for all active trains.
The system shall record and log all signalling commands, train movements, and system alerts for auditing purposes.
queries.why: Operational event logging; the baseline's audit-log principle is about security-relevant actions (logins, permission changes), so it may or may not apply. Every other source, e.g. KYC/AML transaction logging, clearly does not.

queries.text: The system shall achieve a reliability and availability rating meeting Safety Integrity Level 4 (SIL 4) standards to prevent collisions.
queries.why: The domain-agnostic baseline mentions uptime targets, which is not a railway safety obligation; arguable either way. Every other source clearly does not apply.

queries.text: The system shall process and transmit train movement authorities with a latency of less than 100 milliseconds.
The system shall undergo rigorous verification and validation processes to comply with established railway safety standards prior to deployment.
The system shall allow customers to browse restaurant menus and place orders.
The system shall allow couriers to accept, manage, and update the status of delivery assignments.
The system shall provide customers with real-time tracking of their delivery location.
The system shall support promotional campaigns and loyalty programs for customers.
The system shall process secure digital payments for customer orders.
The system shall be structured into modular services that allow independent deployment without affecting other services.
The system shall encrypt all payment transactions and sensitive user data in transit and at rest.
The real-time delivery tracking feature shall update location data with a latency of less than 3 seconds.
The system architecture shall scale individual services independently to handle peak ordering hours.
The system shall verify the applicant's identity documents and proof of address before approving a loan.
The system shall provide declined applicants with the reason for the credit decision.
The system shall disclose interest rates and fees before the borrower commits to the loan.
The system shall flag unusually large or rapid fund transfers for human review.
The system shall tokenize card numbers instead of storing them.
The system shall require multi-factor authentication for customer login.
The system shall notify affected users and the regulator after a personal data breach.
The system shall let users request deletion of their personal data.
The system shall encrypt video consultation streams end to end.
The system shall obtain explicit patient consent before sharing records with insurers.
The system shall generate a weekly stock-level report per warehouse.
The system shall update the leaderboard within 5 seconds of a match ending.
